v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given day Monday, when no event provided, then give times available
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given day with events, when slots are suggested, then non-conflicting times are suggested
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given duration, when slots are available, then

v1_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Starting time plus duration exceeding 17:00 will not be seen
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Starting time plus duration conflicting with reserved meeting will not be seen
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Given existing events, times conflicting will not be available
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Past times will not be suggested
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Past days will not be suggested

v1_human_g2_goal: The objective of the system is to provide the user with available time slots for meetings, while respecting any conflicts or events
v1_human_g2_input:
(1) Events -> Type lists of Dictionary of strings. {"01:00", "02:00"} shows start and end times
(2) Meeting Duration -> Type integer, shows length of meeting in minutes
(3) Day -> Type string, the letter objective, shows the day of meeting
v1_human_g2_output: function returns list of valid start times in ascending order
